entities.name: Pia Nalaar
entities.description: A commentator on the race who praises the Guidelight Voyagers and Loot's curiosity.

entities.name: Guidelight Voyagers
entities.description: Racing competitors said to exhibit more humanity than their flesh-and-blood rivals.

entities.name: Endriders
entities.description: Racers who joined in a series of crashes for fun.

entities.name: Jalpari
entities.description: Reclusive merfolk roused from the depths by the Invasion who have since integrated into Avishkari society.

entities.name: Avishkar
entities.description: A plane whose society integrated the jalpari and whose researchers studied Muraganda.

entities.name: The Invasion
entities.description: A past catastrophe that roused the jalpari and spurred inventions to fight the Phyrexians.

entities.name: Mu Yanling
entities.description: A wind rider searching for her lost mentor.

entities.name: Aether Rangers
entities.description: A racing team whose vehicles were heavily modified during the race.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A man with a plan who lacked the time to explain it, and who comments on what is needed from Loot.

entities.name: Vnwxt
entities.description: A verbose host who starts the race.

entities.name: Amonkhet
entities.description: A plane undergoing rebirth.

entities.name: Zahur
entities.description: A speaker who wants others to witness Amonkhet's rebirth.

entities.name: Gastal
entities.description: A group with vampires who took fuel from the dead.

entities.name: Winter
entities.description: A racer shown in his rearview mirror what awaits him should he fail; he calls Loot brave.

entities.name: Speedbrood
entities.description: Racers who are gregarious when not racing.

entities.name: Loot
entities.description: A young being, older than nearly every living thing, with an extraordinary ability to predict Omenpaths, protected by Chandra, Jace and others.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A fighter who works with Loot to make an entrance and vows to keep him safe.

entities.name: Speedbump
entities.description: A racer who has survived ninety-nine rocket crashes.

entities.name: Rashmi
entities.description: An aether-seer who comments on Muraganda's fauna.

entities.name: Muraganda
entities.description: A plane of steaming jungles whose varied fauna results from raw magic; a stage of the race.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: Enemies against whom many inventions were built.

entities.name: Omenpaths
entities.description: Paths that Loot can predict.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: An ally worried that Loot lacks experience.

events.summary: The Endriders joined in after four accidental crashes.
events.quote: Then the Endriders joined the fun.

events.summary: In the past, the Invasion roused the jalpari, who then integrated into Avishkari society.
events.quote: The Invasion roused the reclusive jalpari from the depths.

events.summary: Mu Yanling continues searching for her lost mentor.
events.quote: The search for her lost mentor continued.

events.summary: Jace lacks time to explain his plan and win support.
events.quote: Unfortunately, time was in short supply.

events.summary: Winter sees in his rearview mirror what awaits him if he fails.
events.quote: The rearview mirror showed Winter what awaited him should he fail.

events.summary: Chandra plans a grand entrance with Loot and soon regrets it.
events.quote: In less than fifteen minutes, she came to regret those words.

events.summary: Loot is rescued and prefers his new rescuers.
events.quote: Loot decided he liked these rescuers much more than the last ones.
